style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon in the style of the 'Ecomonos' YouTube channel. PURE WHITE background as the default. Thick bold black ink outlines, flat solid colors, NO gradients, NO blur, NO depth of field, NO glow effects, NO soft shading — everything sharp, crisp and clean like a marker drawing. A recurring brown cartoon monkey character with VERY LARGE round white eyes and small black pupils, and a hugely exaggerated expressive face (wide toothy grin, shocked open mouth, half-lidded smug look, or furrowed angry brow depending on the moment). The monkey is BIG in frame, occupying roughly 40-60% of the image — never a tiny figure lost in a wide empty scene. Props and objects are drawn in bright saturated colors (yellow, orange, red, green, blue) that pop against the white background. The image must contain NO text at all: no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no signs and no labels. Every poster, plaque, shield, price tag, badge, calendar, screen and sheet of paper is drawn completely BLANK. The Spanish captions are added afterwards in the edit, so drawing them here would duplicate them and misspell them. Tell the whole idea with drawing, gesture and facial expression alone. Characters have exactly two arms and two hands. Only use a dark or moody background when the scene itself is explicitly at night, in a dark room, or lit by police lights — otherwise the background stays white. Variante limpia del estilo Ecomonos: fondo blanco puro, contorno negro grueso, colores planos, mono marron con ojos enormes blancos. Cuando la escena lo pida, dibuja DENTRO de la imagen (nunca superpuesto) una cifra grande y, como mucho, una palabra corta en espanol relacionada con ESA escena concreta — nunca reutilices cifras ni palabras de otras escenas, cada imagen lleva solo el numero/texto que su propia descripcion de escena pide, y si la escena no pide ninguna cifra no dibujes ninguna.
